entities.name: Leishmaniasis
entities.description: A vector-borne protozoal infection caused by obligate intracellular parasites of the genus Leishmania, presenting as visceral leishmaniasis (kala-azar with prolonged undulating fever, massive splenomegaly, pancytopenia, and hypergammaglobulinemia), cutaneous leishmaniasis (crateriform volcano-like ulcers with intact sensation), or mucocutaneous leishmaniasis (progressive destruction of naso-oropharyngeal cartilage).

entities.name: Visceral Leishmaniasis
entities.description: Systemic reticuloendothelial infection caused by L. donovani and L. infantum, characterized by chronic undulating fever, massive splenomegaly, and fatal wasting.

entities.name: Cutaneous Leishmaniasis
entities.description: Localized dermal infection manifesting as slowly expanding papules, nodules, and chronic crateriform ulcerations at sandfly inoculation sites.

entities.name: Mucocutaneous Leishmaniasis
entities.description: Metastatic mucosal complication caused predominantly by L. braziliensis, resulting in progressive necrotizing destruction of nasopharyngeal cartilages.

entities.name: Post Kala Azar Dermatosis
entities.description: Dermatological sequel occurring months to years after treated visceral leishmaniasis, characterized by hypopigmented macules and parasite-dense facial nodules.

entities.name: Diffuse Cutaneous Leishmaniasis
entities.description: Rare anergic form caused by L. amazonensis or L. aethiopica, manifesting as widespread non-ulcerative keloid-like nodules and plaques.

entities.name: Chiclero Ulcer
entities.description: Mutilating cutaneous-chondral ulceration of the ear pinna caused by L. mexicana among forest workers in Central America.

entities.name: Oriental Sore
entities.description: Classic solitary Old World cutaneous ulceration caused by L. major or L. tropica in the Middle East and Mediterranean.

entities.name: Leishmania Recidivans
entities.description: Chronic hyperergic recurrence presenting as apple-jelly lupoid papules clustering around the edges of previously healed cutaneous scars.

entities.name: Disseminated Cutaneous Leishmaniasis
entities.description: Cutaneous variant featuring dozens of distant pleomorphic acneiform papules and ulcers emerging rapidly from a primary lesion.

entities.name: Mucosal Septal Perforation
entities.description: Complete full-thickness erosive destruction of the cartilaginous nasal septum, leading to collapse of the nasal bridge.

entities.name: Tapir Nose Deformity
entities.description: Severe craniofacial disfigurement characterized by tumefaction and downward projection of the nose and upper lip resembling a tapir snout.

entities.name: Palatal Mucosal Destruction
entities.description: Extensive granulomatous necrosis and perforation of the hard and soft palates, impairing speech and deglutition.

entities.name: Laryngeal Cartilage Ulceration
entities.description: Destructive granulomatous ulceration of epiglottic and laryngeal structures causing chronic dysphonia and airway narrowing.

entities.name: Auricular Chondral Necrosis
entities.description: Avascular necrosis and enzymatic lysis of elastic auricular cartilage caused by persistent L. mexicana infection.

entities.name: Uta Andean Leishmaniasis
entities.description: High-altitude Andean cutaneous leishmaniasis caused by L. peruviana, presenting as benign, self-healing facial ulcers in children.

entities.name: Bejuco Ulcer
entities.description: Rural cutaneous leishmaniasis syndrome in Panama and Costa Rica caused by L. panamensis, producing multiple shallow ulcers.

entities.name: Reticuloendothelial Parasitization
entities.description: Systemic invasion and intracellular multiplication of amastigotes within fixed tissue macrophages throughout the liver, spleen, and bone marrow.

entities.name: Severe Consumptive Cachexia
entities.description: Profound catabolic state characterized by severe muscle wasting, emaciation, and temporal hollowing driven by chronic TNF-alpha elevation.

entities.name: Protuberant Abdomen
entities.description: Marked abdominal enlargement contrasting sharply with wasting of the extremities, driven by gigantic splenic and hepatic enlargement.

entities.name: Dermal Maculopapular Rash
entities.description: Erythematous, hypopigmented macules and papules coalescing across the malar facial areas, neck, and upper chest.

entities.name: Facial Infiltrative Plaques
entities.description: Indurated, reddish-brown smooth or verrucous plaques infiltrating the forehead, cheeks, and earlobes reminiscent of lepromatous leprosy.

entities.name: Oropharyngeal Dysphagia
entities.description: Inability to swallow solid foods or liquids caused by painful ulcerative destruction of the posterior pharynx and uvula.

entities.name: Upper Airway Stridor
entities.description: Inspiratory wheezing and high-pitched stridor resulting from edematous inflammatory stenosis of the glottis and epiglottis.

entities.name: Severe Mucosal Odynophagia
entities.description: Intense burning pain on deglutition resulting from deep mucosal erosion and secondary bacterial colonization of the pharyngeal mucosa.

entities.name: Epistaxis and Rhinitis
entities.description: Recurrent nosebleeds, persistent nasal stuffiness, and foul-smelling purulent crusts signaling early cartilaginous mucosal involvement.

entities.name: Pediatric Growth Retardation
entities.description: Severe growth deceleration, stunting, and wasting in young children suffering from chronic visceral leishmaniasis.

entities.name: Pediatric Chronic Diarrhea
entities.description: Protracted loose stools and malabsorption accompanying visceral leishmaniasis in infants and toddlers.

entities.name: Generalized Lymphadenopathy
entities.description: Firm, discrete, non-tender enlargement of cervical, axillary, epitrochlear, and inguinal lymph node chains.

entities.name: Secondary Bacterial Superinfection
entities.description: Superimposed streptococcal or staphylococcal cellulitis producing acute purulent exudate, regional tenderness, and erythema over chronic ulcers.

entities.name: Spontaneous Dermal Ulceration
entities.description: Ischemic liquefaction and dermal breakdown in the center of an indurated cutaneous nodule creating a chronic ulcer.

entities.name: Satellite Papular Lesions
entities.description: Small secondary inflammatory papules arranged in a halo-like pattern around the active raised indurated border of a primary ulcer.

entities.name: Sporotrichoid Lymphocutaneous Dissemination
entities.description: Linear array of subcutaneous inflammatory nodules ascending along regional lymphatic drainage pathways proximal to a primary cutaneous ulcer.

entities.name: Mucosal Granulomatous Vegetation
entities.description: Exophytic, friable, hyperplastic granulomatous masses projecting from the nasal septum or pharyngeal walls.

entities.name: Epithelioid Tuberculoid Granuloma
entities.description: Histopathological dermal formation of organized epithelioid histiocytes, Langhans multinucleated giant cells, and dense lymphocytic mantles.

entities.name: Depressed Retractile Cicatrix
entities.description: Characteristic parchment-like, depressed, cribriform scar with hyperpigmented borders and telangiectasias following spontaneous or treated ulcer resolution.

entities.name: Progressive Asthenia
entities.description: Severe, debilitating generalized lethargy and muscle weakness out of proportion to exertion.

entities.name: Profuse Nocturnal Diaphoresis
entities.description: Drenching night sweats accompanied by temperature defervescence during chronic remittent fever spikes in visceral leishmaniasis.

entities.name: Spontaneous Gingival Bleeding
entities.description: Bleeding from gums, oral mucosa, and minor abrasions provoked by profound peripheral platelet destruction.

entities.name: Peripheral Pitting Edema
entities.description: Bilateral dependent pitting edema of the lower extremities and presacral area.

entities.name: Secondary Pyogenic Sepsis
entities.description: Life-threatening systemic bacterial infection, including lobar pneumonia, enteritis, or septicemia, complicating severe visceral neutropenia.

entities.name: Massive Splenomegaly
entities.description: Enormous, firm, non-tender spleen extending well past the umbilicus down to the right iliac fossa or pelvic brim.

entities.name: Dromedary Fever Curve
entities.description: Classical temperature chart displaying two distinct high febrile spikes within a single 24-hour period.

entities.name: Ashen Gray Hyperpigmentation
entities.description: Peculiar grayish-black hyperpigmentation of the hands, feet, forehead, and abdominal wall that gives kala-azar its name.

entities.name: Crateriform Skin Ulcer
entities.description: Indolent volcano-like cutaneous ulcer displaying a depressed necrotic base oozing serous fluid beneath an adherent crust.

entities.name: Indurated Violaceous Border
entities.description: Sharply demarcated, raised, firm, violaceous or hyperemic rolled peripheral rim surrounding the ulcer crater.

entities.name: Intact Cutaneous Sensation
entities.description: Completely preserved tactile, thermal, and pinprick sensation within and surrounding the cutaneous ulceration.

entities.name: Smooth Firm Hepatomegaly
entities.description: Moderate, uniform, non-tender liver enlargement with a smooth edge palpable 3 to 8 cm below the right costal margin.

entities.name: Nontender Lymphadenopathy
entities.description: Enlarged, firm, discrete, non-matted, painless lymph nodes palpable in multiple anatomical stations.

entities.name: Granulation Base Bleeding
entities.description: Bleeding easily upon minimal contact or mechanical scraping of the granular pink floor of a cutaneous ulcer.

entities.name: Exudative Whitish Pseudomembrane
entities.description: Adherent whitish or yellowish necrotic fibrinous exudate partially covering the central depression of the lesion.

entities.name: Ear Pinna Notch
entities.description: Permanent notched or cleft-like tissue defect of the superior auricular helix caused by cartilage reabsorption.

entities.name: Nasal Septal Destruction
entities.description: Transmural necrosis and visible anterior perforation of the cartilaginous nasal septum on anterior rhinoscopy.

entities.name: Uvular Granulomatous Erosion
entities.description: Ulcerative destruction, thickening, and eventual auto-amputation of the uvula visible on oropharyngeal inspection.

entities.name: Brawny Facial Lymphedema
entities.description: Indurated, non-pitting chronic swelling of the nose, upper lip, and cheeks caused by dermal lymphatic block.

entities.name: Temporal Muscle Wasting
entities.description: Deep bilateral excavation of the temporal fossae due to severe temporalis muscle atrophy.

entities.name: Abdominal Venous Distension
entities.description: Prominent superficial collateral veins coursing across the thinned abdominal wall overlying huge hepatosplenomegaly.

entities.name: Nail Bed Pallor
entities.description: Chalky white discoloration of the palmar creases, nail beds, and conjunctivae reflecting profound normocytic anemia.

entities.name: Petechial Skin Purpura
entities.description: Non-blanching pinpoint red spots and larger ecchymoses scattered over the lower extremities and pressure points.

entities.name: Dry Thinning Hair
entities.description: Sparse, brittle, lusterless scalp hair with patchy loss of pigmentation and premature diffuse shedding.

entities.name: Xerosis Cutis
entities.description: Widespread dry, coarse, scaly ichthyosiform skin changes covering the extensor surfaces of the extremities.

entities.name: Hypopigmented Facial Macules
entities.description: Multiple, small, coalescing pale macules distributed symmetrically across the butterfly area of the face and neck.

entities.name: Perioral Nodular Eruptions
entities.description: Dense clusters of firm, non-tender, erythematous fleshy papules and nodules encircling the lips and chin.

entities.name: Nonulcerating Verrucous Plaques
entities.description: Broad, hyperkeratotic, warty plaques covering large expanses of the limbs and trunk that never undergo ulceration.

entities.name: Hoarse Whispering Dysphonia
entities.description: Strained, breathy, raspy voice quality progressing to a weak whisper caused by mucosal vocal fold thickening.

entities.name: Saddle Nose Deformity
entities.description: Sunken, depressed nasal bridge caused by complete loss of the underlying quadrangular cartilage support.

entities.name: Soft Palate Granuloma
entities.description: Velvety, hyperemic, cobblestone-like mucosal granulations studding the soft palate and anterior tonsillar pillars.

entities.name: Localized Erythematous Papule
entities.description: Single, firm, non-tender, itchy or asymptomatic reddish papule measuring 2 to 10 mm at the site of the sandfly bite.

entities.name: Preserved Peripheral Nerves
entities.description: Normal caliber and non-tender texture of great auricular, ulnar, and superficial peroneal nerves without nodularity.

entities.name: Profound Pancytopenia
entities.description: Simultaneous severe depression of red blood cells, white blood cells, and platelets on admission complete blood count.

entities.name: Severe Normocytic Anemia
entities.description: Normocytic normochromic anemia with hemoglobin levels frequently dropping below 7.0 g/dL.

entities.name: Profound Leukopenia
entities.description: Total white blood cell count severely depressed below 2500 cells per microliter.

entities.name: Absolute Neutropenia
entities.description: Absolute neutrophil count dropping below 1000 cells per microliter (often < 500/uL).

entities.name: Severe Thrombocytopenia
entities.description: Platelet count severely reduced below 50,000 to 80,000 per microliter.

entities.name: Polyclonal Hypergammaglobulinemia
entities.description: Astronomical elevation of polyclonal IgG with total serum globulin reaching 6 to 9 g/dL.

entities.name: Inverted Albumin Globulin Ratio
entities.description: Reversal of the normal albumin-to-globulin ratio to less than 0.5 (often < 0.3).

entities.name: Marked Hypoalbuminemia
entities.description: Serum albumin level markedly depressed below 2.5 g/dL (often < 2.0 g/dL).

entities.name: Intracellular Amastigote Visualization
entities.description: Microscopic identification of round-to-oval 2-4 um aflagellated amastigotes within macrophage cytoplasm on Giemsa stain.

entities.name: Splenic Aspirate Smear
entities.description: Giemsa-stained microscopic smear of splenic aspirate demonstrating amastigotes with greater than 95% sensitivity.

entities.name: Bone Marrow Aspirate
entities.description: Microscopic examination of bone marrow aspirate revealing intracellular amastigotes with 70% to 85% sensitivity.

entities.name: Lymph Node Aspirate
entities.description: Needle aspiration of enlarged peripheral lymph nodes revealing amastigotes with 50% to 60% diagnostic yield.

entities.name: Purplish Kinetoplast Rod
entities.description: Distinctive rod-shaped extranuclear organelle oriented perpendicular to the round nucleus inside amastigotes.

entities.name: rK39 Dipstick RDT
entities.description: Recombinant kinesin-related protein 39 immunochromatographic rapid dipstick test demonstrating >98% sensitivity in South Asia.

entities.name: Direct Agglutination Test
entities.description: High-titer agglutination of Coomassie blue-stained whole promastigotes by patient serum (>1:3200 titer).

entities.name: Positive Montenegro Reaction
entities.description: Delayed-type hypersensitivity skin test induration greater than 5 mm measured 48 to 72 hours after antigen injection.

entities.name: Negative Montenegro Reaction
entities.description: Absence of dermal induration (<5 mm) to intradermal leishmanin during active visceral and diffuse cutaneous disease.

entities.name: Homogeneous Splenomegaly Ultrasound
entities.description: Bedside abdominal ultrasound demonstrating an enormous spleen with preserved uniform, homogeneous parenchymal echotexture.

entities.name: Smooth Hepatomegaly Ultrasound
entities.description: Sonographic demonstration of diffuse, uniform hepatic enlargement with regular borders and normal acoustic architecture.

entities.name: Dilated Portal Vein
entities.description: Mild-to-moderate enlargement of main portal vein diameter on Doppler ultrasound resulting from massive splenic venous inflow.

entities.name: Absence of Splenic Abscess
entities.description: Complete lack of focal hypoechoic or liquefied cystic collections within the splenic parenchyma on ultrasound.

entities.name: Mild Transaminase Elevation
entities.description: Serum AST and ALT moderately elevated 2 to 3 times the upper limit of normal.

entities.name: Normal Serum Bilirubin
entities.description: Normal or only minimally elevated total and direct serum bilirubin levels (<1.5 mg/dL).

entities.name: Elevated Serum Ferritin
entities.description: Extreme serum ferritin elevation frequently exceeding 1000 to 5000 ng/mL.

entities.name: Elevated Erythrocyte Sedimentation
entities.description: Marked acceleration of erythrocyte sedimentation rate frequently exceeding 100 mm in the first hour.

entities.name: Elevated C Reactive Protein
entities.description: Significant rise in serum C-reactive protein levels reflecting ongoing chronic systemic inflammation.

entities.name: Microscopic Hematuria
entities.description: Presence of red blood cells and mild non-nephrotic proteinuria on routine admission urinalysis.

entities.name: Negative Blood Malarial Smear
entities.description: Absence of intraerythrocytic plasmodial trophozoites, schizonts, or gametocytes on repeated Giemsa smears.

entities.name: Dermal Scraping Smear
entities.description: Giemsa-stained microscopic smear taken from the active indurated ulcer border demonstrating intracellular amastigotes.

entities.name: Novy MacNeal Nicolle Culture
entities.description: Biphasic rabbit-blood agar medium yielding motile flagellated promastigotes after 1 to 3 weeks of incubation at 24-26 C.

entities.name: Positive Kinetoplast DNA PCR
entities.description: Polymerase chain reaction amplification of conserved Leishmania kinetoplast minicircle DNA targets.

entities.name: Urine Leishmania Antigen
entities.description: Latex agglutination or ELISA detection of low-molecular-weight carbohydrate leishmanial antigens excreted in patient urine.

entities.name: Normal Blood Coagulation Profile
entities.description: Preserved prothrombin time (PT) and international normalized ratio (INR) despite splenomegaly and pancytopenia.

entities.name: Histiocytic Vacuolar Infiltration
entities.description: Histological demonstration of large dermal histiocytes packed with cytoplasm vacuoles containing multiple amastigotes.

entities.name: Negative Acid Fast Stain
entities.description: Absence of red acid-fast bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen staining of tissue scraping or biopsy.

entities.name: Normal Peripheral Blood Smear
entities.description: Absence of immature myeloid or lymphoid blast cells, Auer rods, or dysplastic megakaryocytes on blood film review.

entities.name: Absence of Biliary Dilatation
entities.description: Ultrasound confirmation of normal caliber intrahepatic and extrahepatic biliary ducts without calculi or sludge.

entities.name: Normal Plain Chest Radiograph
entities.description: Chest X-ray showing clear lung fields without apical cavitations, lobar consolidations, or hilar adenopathy.

entities.name: Phlebotomus Sandfly Bite
entities.description: Bite of tiny (1.5-3 mm) female Phlebotomus sandflies transmitting Leishmania donovani, L. infantum, L. major, or L. tropica in the Old World.

entities.name: Lutzomyia Sandfly Bite
entities.description: Inoculation by female Lutzomyia sandflies transmitting Leishmania braziliensis, L. mexicana, or L. chagasi in Central and South America.

entities.name: Canine Reservoir Exposure
entities.description: Close domestic or peri-urban contact with domestic dogs harboring Leishmania infantum in the Mediterranean and Latin America.

entities.name: Sylvatic Rodent Habitat
entities.description: Forest ecosystems inhabited by wild rodents and marsupials maintaining zoonotic cutaneous Leishmania species.

entities.name: Cracked Mud Dwelling
entities.description: Earthen, thatched, or cracked mud houses in rural villages offering humid microhabitats for sandfly resting and breeding.

entities.name: Nocturnal Outdoor Sleeping
entities.description: Sleeping outdoors or on ground mats without protective bed nets during peak sandfly biting hours between dusk and dawn.

entities.name: Rainforest Occupational Exposure
entities.description: Work in Neotropical primary forests, including gum tree (chicle) harvesting, logging, mining, military maneuvers, and ecotourism.

entities.name: Bihar Endemic Plains
entities.description: Residence in or travel through the rural Gangetic floodplains of Eastern India, Bangladesh, and Nepal.

entities.name: East African Savannah
entities.description: Arid and acacia savannah zones of Sudan, South Sudan, Ethiopia, Somalia, and Kenya supporting Phlebotomus orientalis vectors.

entities.name: Mediterranean Basin Travel
entities.description: Residence or holiday travel in coastal Southern Europe (Spain, Italy, Greece) and North Africa harboring Leishmania infantum.

entities.name: Latin American Rainforest
entities.description: Humid tropical forest environments across Brazil, Peru, and Bolivia accounting for over 90% of mucocutaneous leishmaniasis cases.

entities.name: HIV AIDS Coinfection
entities.description: Profound cell-mediated immune deficiency from human immunodeficiency virus accelerating visceral leishmaniasis progression.

entities.name: Protein Energy Malnutrition
entities.description: Nutritional deficits in protein, iron, and zinc impairing macrophage parasiticidal nitric oxide production.

entities.name: Pharmacologic Immunosuppression
entities.description: Iatrogenic T-cell suppression from systemic corticosteroids, chemotherapy, solid organ transplantation, or anti-TNF biologics.

entities.name: Intravenous Needle Sharing
entities.description: Direct parenteral transmission of Leishmania infantum amastigotes through contaminated needles among intravenous drug users.

entities.name: Young Pediatric Age
entities.description: Infants and children under 5 years of age possessing immunologically immature cell-mediated responses.

entities.name: Nonimmune Immigrant Status
entities.description: Displaced refugees, seasonal agricultural laborers, or military personnel entering endemic transmission foci.

entities.name: Indolent Incubation Months
entities.description: Subacute incubation timeline for visceral leishmaniasis, typically ranging from 2 to 8 months (extremes: 10 days to 2 years).

entities.name: Cutaneous Incubation Weeks
entities.description: Incubation interval for localized cutaneous leishmaniasis, typically spanning 2 to 8 weeks before papule ulceration.

entities.name: Delayed Mucosal Latency
entities.description: Protracted asymptomatic latency spanning months to several years between healed cutaneous ulcer and mucocutaneous espundia.

entities.name: Termite Mound Proximity
entities.description: Living or herding livestock near abandoned termite mounds and acacia trees in African savannah habitats.

entities.name: Post Conflict Migration
entities.description: Civil unrest, warfare, and refugee camp settlement associated with breakdown in housing and vector control.

entities.name: Marked Neutrophilic Leukocytosis
entities.description: Elevated total white blood cell count exceeding 15,000 cells/uL with pronounced left shift.

entities.name: Absence of Splenomegaly
entities.description: Normal splenic size on physical palpation and abdominal imaging in a chronically febrile patient.

entities.name: Anesthetic Skin Lesion
entities.description: Complete loss of thermal or pinprick pain sensation within a cutaneous plaque or ulceration.

entities.name: Painful Purulent Ulcer
entities.description: Acute exquisitely tender ulcer with copious foul-smelling pus and warm surrounding erythema without indolence.

entities.name: Enlarged Peripheral Nerves
entities.description: Palpable thickened, tender, cord-like peripheral nerve trunks with distal sensorimotor deficits.

entities.name: Acute Onset Twentyfour Hours
entities.description: Hyperacute onset of high fever and systemic symptoms developing within 24 to 48 hours of exposure.

entities.name: Hyperbilirubinemic Overt Jaundice
entities.description: Deep clinical scleral icterus with marked conjugated hyperbilirubinemia (>5 mg/dL) at initial presentation.

entities.name: Intrahepatic Cystic Lesions
entities.description: Ultrasound demonstration of discrete fluid-filled round cysts with internal septations or daughter vesicles.

entities.name: Rapid Antibacterial Response
entities.description: Prompt fever defervescence and symptom resolution within 48 to 72 hours of empiric beta-lactam therapy.

entities.name: Marked Absolute Eosinophilia
entities.description: Severe peripheral blood absolute eosinophilia exceeding 3000 cells per microliter.

entities.name: Circulating Peripheral Blasts
entities.description: Presence of immature leukemic myeloblasts or lymphoblasts on peripheral blood examination.

entities.name: Intraerythrocytic Plasmodial Rings
entities.description: Microscopic identification of delicate blue ring forms with red chromatin dots within erythrocytes.

entities.name: Pipestem Periportal Fibrosis
entities.description: Prominent echogenic perivenous fibrous cuffing along intrahepatic portal vein branches on ultrasound.

entities.name: Acid Fast Bacilli
entities.description: Demonstration of bright red, rod-shaped acid-fast organisms on Ziehl-Neelsen stained tissue smears.

entities.name: Centrally Painful Eschar
entities.description: Tender necrotic black eschar accompanied by intense surrounding edema and severe regional adenitis.

entities.name: Caseating Granulomatous Necrosis
entities.description: Histological demonstration of extensive eosinophilic acellular caseous necrosis with Langhans giant cells.

entities.name: Normal Serum Immunoglobulins
entities.description: Completely normal total serum protein (6.0-8.0 g/dL) and normal serum IgG immunoglobulin levels.

entities.name: Prompt Antimalarial Response
entities.description: Complete resolution of fever and clearance of parasitemia within 48 hours of artemisinin-based combination therapy.

entities.name: Pure Scalp Lesions
entities.description: Cutaneous ulcerative lesions localized exclusively to the densely haired scalp.

entities.name: Solitary Lung Cavitation
entities.description: Chest radiography demonstrating a dominant thick-walled apical pulmonary cavity with air-fluid levels.

entities.name: Normal Spleen Size
entities.description: Sonographic verification of normal splenic craniocaudal length (<12 cm) in a chronically unwell patient.

entities.name: Severe Hemolysis Bilirubin
entities.description: Acute intravascular hemolysis with hemoglobinuria, dark urine, and massive indirect hyperbilirubinemia.

entities.name: Malaria
entities.description: Major look-alike tropical parasitic disease sharing splenomegaly, anemia, fever, and tropical travel history.

entities.name: Schistosomiasis
entities.description: Trematode infection presenting with massive hepatosplenomegaly, portal hypertension, and gastrointestinal variceal bleeding.

entities.name: Leprosy
entities.description: Chronic mycobacterial infection causing cutaneous macules, plaques, nodules, and mucosal infiltration.

entities.name: Cutaneous Anthrax
entities.description: Zoonotic bacterial infection presenting with painless cutaneous ulceration and central black necrotic eschar.

entities.name: Disseminated Histoplasmosis
entities.description: Dimorphic fungal infection manifesting with fever, hepatosplenomegaly, pancytopenia, and mucosal ulcers in immunocompromised hosts.

entities.name: Visceral Brucellosis
entities.description: Zoonotic bacterial infection presenting with chronic undulant fever, hepatosplenomegaly, and cytopenias after unpasteurized dairy ingestion.

entities.name: Typhoid Fever
entities.description: Systemic enteric salmonellosis causing prolonged fever, splenomegaly, abdominal symptoms, and leukopenia.

entities.name: Tropical Splenomegaly Syndrome
entities.description: Aberrant immunological response to chronic malaria causing massive splenomegaly and hypersplenism.

entities.name: Cutaneous Tuberculosis
entities.description: Mycobacterial skin infection presenting as chronic plaque, ulcer, or lupus vulgaris nodule.

entities.name: Acute Myeloid Leukemia
entities.description: Hematological malignancy presenting with severe pancytopenia, fever, weight loss, and splenomegaly.

entities.name: Hodgkin Lymphoma
entities.description: Lymphoid malignancy presenting with B-symptoms (fever, night sweats, weight loss), splenomegaly, and lymphadenopathy.

entities.name: Amebic Liver Abscess
entities.description: Invasive protozoal infection presenting with fever, tender right upper quadrant hepatomegaly, and leukocytosis.

entities.name: Bacterial Pyoderma
entities.description: Acute superficial or deep cutaneous bacterial infection causing crusting pustules and tender ulcerations.

entities.name: Sporotrichosis
entities.description: Subcutaneous mycosis inoculated by vegetation thorns causing ulcerating nodules tracking along regional lymphatics.

entities.name: Yaws
entities.description: Endemic non-venereal treponematosis causing papillomatous frambesiomas and ulcerating bone and skin lesions in children.

entities.name: Paracoccidioidomycosis
entities.description: Endemic South American deep mycosis causing ulcerative mucosal lesions and lymphadenopathy in agricultural workers.

entities.name: Chromoblastomycosis
entities.description: Chronic fungal infection causing slow-growing, cauliflower-like, hyperkeratotic verrucous plaques on lower extremities.

entities.name: Buruli Ulcer
entities.description: Necrotizing cutaneous mycobacterial infection caused by Mycobacterium ulcerans producing extensive painless ulcers.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, visceral leishmaniasis, kala-azar, black fever, systemic infection
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leishmaniasis manifests as visceral leishmaniasis (kala-azar), an indolent systemic protozoal infection marked by extensive macrophage parasitization across the spleen, liver, and bone marrow.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, cutaneous leishmaniasis, oriental sore, skin ulcer
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leishmaniasis manifests as cutaneous leishmaniasis, initiating as a bite-site erythematous papule that gradually breaks down into a characteristic painless, indurated ulcer.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, mucocutaneous leishmaniasis, espundia, mucosal destruction
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leishmaniasis manifests as mucocutaneous leishmaniasis (espundia), where metastatic lymphatic or hematogenous dissemination leads to granulomatous cartilage destruction in the nose, palate, and larynx.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, post-kala-azar dermal leishmaniasis, PKDL, macular rash, cutaneous sequel
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leishmaniasis manifests as post-kala-azar dermal leishmaniasis (PKDL), an immune-mediated sequel following visceral cure presenting with hypopigmented macules, papules, and nodular rashes rich in amastigotes.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, diffuse cutaneous leishmaniasis, anergic leishmaniasis, keloidal nodules
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leishmaniasis manifests as diffuse cutaneous leishmaniasis, a severe anergic form characterized by defective T-cell immunity and progressive dissemination of non-ulcerating nodular plaques across the integument.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, chiclero ulcer, ear pinna ulcer, chondral destruction
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leishmaniasis manifests as chiclero ulcer, a chronic destructive ulceration localized to the pinna of the ear that erodes auricular cartilage causing permanent notched deformities.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, oriental sore, Old World leishmaniasis, crusted ulcer
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leishmaniasis manifests as oriental sore, presenting as a solitary self-limiting or chronic crusted volcano-like ulcer on exposed facial or limb surfaces.

relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leishmaniasis manifests as Leishmania recidivans (lupoid leishmaniasis), where persistent viable parasites produce chronic granulomatous papules spreading around old healed scar margins.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, disseminated cutaneous leishmaniasis, multiple ulcers, metastatic lesions
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leishmaniasis manifests as disseminated cutaneous leishmaniasis, exhibiting rapid hematogenous dissemination of multiple ulcerative or papular lesions across disparate non-contiguous body areas.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, tapir nose deformity, espundia, facial disfigurement
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leishmaniasis manifests as tapir nose deformity, an advanced stage of mucocutaneous leishmaniasis where severe soft tissue swelling and cartilaginous collapse distort the nasofacial architecture.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, palatal mucosal destruction, hard palate erosion, oral espundia
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leishmaniasis manifests as palatal mucosal destruction, characterized by progressive ulceration, detachment, and perforation of the palatine mucosa and alveolar arches.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, laryngeal cartilage ulceration, vocal cord granuloma, stridor
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leishmaniasis manifests as laryngeal cartilage ulceration, producing severe hoarseness, stridor, and potential acute respiratory compromise from mucosal granulation tissue.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, auricular chondral necrosis, ear cartilage loss, chiclero ulcer
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leishmaniasis manifests as auricular chondral necrosis, leading to chronic painless resorption of the ear helix and antihelix with permanent scalloped tissue loss.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, uta, Andean leishmaniasis, L. peruviana
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leishmaniasis manifests as Uta Andean leishmaniasis, a distinct benign epidemiological form endemic to the high Peruvian valleys characterized by solitary self-limiting facial skin ulcers.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, bejuco ulcer, Central American leishmaniasis, L. panamensis
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leishmaniasis manifests as Bejuco ulcer, an endemic Central American manifestation of L. panamensis infection affecting young forest travelers with nodular ulcerative skin sores.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, reticuloendothelial parasitization, macrophage invasion, organomegaly
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leishmaniasis manifests as reticuloendothelial parasitization, leading to massive compensatory hyperplasia of splenic red pulp, hepatic Kupffer cells, and marrow sinusoids.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, severe consumptive cachexia, visceral wasting, temporal hollowing
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leishmaniasis manifests as severe consumptive cachexia, presenting with marked weight loss, loss of subcutaneous fat stores, and profound physical debility in prolonged visceral disease.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, protuberant abdomen, abdominal distension, hepatosplenomegaly
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leishmaniasis manifests as a protuberant abdomen, wherein massive splenomegaly and hepatomegaly produce gross abdominal distension in emaciated pediatric and adult patients.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, dermal maculopapular rash, post-kala-azar eruption, PKDL lesions
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leishmaniasis manifests as a dermal maculopapular rash, commonly seen during initial stages of PKDL before progression to nodular granulomas.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, facial infiltrative plaques, lepromatoid plaques, diffuse leishmaniasis
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leishmaniasis manifests as facial infiltrative plaques, appearing in diffuse cutaneous leishmaniasis as heavily parasitized dermal infiltrates that distort normal facial contours.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, oropharyngeal dysphagia, difficulty swallowing, mucosal espundia
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leishmaniasis manifests as oropharyngeal dysphagia, occurring in advanced mucocutaneous disease when granulomatous ulceration spreads across the palatopharyngeal arch.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, upper airway stridor, laryngeal stenosis, respiratory compromise
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leishmaniasis manifests as upper airway stridor, representing a life-threatening complication of mucocutaneous leishmaniasis caused by mucosal granulation occluding the laryngeal inlet.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, mucosal odynophagia, painful swallowing, ulcerated pharynx
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leishmaniasis manifests as severe mucosal odynophagia, driving nutritional deterioration and dehydration in patients suffering from progressive oral espundia.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, epistaxis, chronic rhinitis, mucosal crusting, early espundia
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leishmaniasis manifests as epistaxis and rhinitis, serving as the earliest clinical warning signs of metastatic mucocutaneous invasion by L. braziliensis.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, pediatric growth retardation, stunting, failure to thrive
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leishmaniasis manifests as pediatric growth retardation, where systemic macrophage cytokine release and hypersplenism halt normal skeletal growth and weight gain.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, pediatric chronic diarrhea, infantile kala-azar, enteropathy
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leishmaniasis manifests as pediatric chronic diarrhea, resulting from extensive parasitic infiltration of the mesenteric lymph nodes and intestinal lamina propria.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, generalized lymphadenopathy, nodal enlargement, East African VL
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leishmaniasis manifests as generalized lymphadenopathy, a particularly prominent clinical presentation in East African visceral leishmaniasis (Sudan, Kenya, Ethiopia).

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, secondary bacterial superinfection, purulent cellulitis, staphylococcal ulcer
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leishmaniasis manifests as secondary bacterial superinfection, altering the classically painless, clean appearance of cutaneous ulcers into painful, purulent lesions.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, spontaneous dermal ulceration, central necrosis, oriental sore
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leishmaniasis manifests as spontaneous dermal ulceration, occurring typically 2 to 4 weeks following the sandfly bite as intracellular macrophage parasite load triggers epidermal necrosis.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, satellite papular lesions, peripheral rim, cutaneous leishmaniasis
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leishmaniasis manifests as satellite papular lesions, reflecting local microscopic centrifugal extension of amastigotes through dermal lymphatic channels.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, sporotrichoid dissemination, nodular lymphangitis, lymphatic tracking
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leishmaniasis manifests as sporotrichoid lymphocutaneous dissemination, predominantly associated with L. braziliensis and L. guyanensis infections.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, mucosal granulomatous vegetation, cauliflower exophytic lesion, espundia
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leishmaniasis manifests as mucosal granulomatous vegetation, causing progressive mechanical airway obstruction and chronic bloody rhinorrhea.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, epithelioid tuberculoid granuloma, histopathology, chronic immune response
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leishmaniasis manifests as epithelioid tuberculoid granuloma, characterizing the late healing hyperergic phase of cutaneous leishmaniasis where parasite density becomes low.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, depressed retractile cicatrix, cribriform scar, healed leishmaniasis
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leishmaniasis manifests as a depressed retractile cicatrix, leaving a permanent disfiguring skin marker on exposed body parts that causes lifelong psychological stigma.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, progressive asthenia, profound fatigue, chronic visceral disease
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leishmaniasis manifests as progressive asthenia, resulting from severe normocytic anemia, chronic catabolic cytokine activation, and progressive visceral failure.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, profuse nocturnal diaphoresis, drenching night sweats, visceral fever
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leishmaniasis manifests as profuse nocturnal diaphoresis, mimicking lymphoma or tuberculosis during prolonged undulant febrile episodes.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, spontaneous gingival bleeding, thrombocytopenic purpura, mucosal hemorrhage
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leishmaniasis manifests as spontaneous gingival bleeding, representing an ominous clinical sign of advanced splenic platelet sequestration and marrow aplasia.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, peripheral pitting edema, pedal swelling, hypoalbuminemia
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leishmaniasis manifests as peripheral pitting edema, caused by diminished plasma oncotic pressure secondary to profound visceral hypoalbuminemia and malnutrition.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, secondary pyogenic sepsis, intercurrent infection, bacterial pneumonia
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Leishmaniasis manifests as secondary pyogenic sepsis, which serves as the proximate cause of mortality in over 50% of untreated visceral leishmaniasis patients.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, dromedary fever curve, double daily spike, twin peaks
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Leishmaniasis exhibits a pathognomonic dromedary fever curve, featuring two separate rigor-associated temperature peaks within each 24-hour daily cycle.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, ashen gray hyperpigmentation, kala-azar, black fever, skin darkening
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Leishmaniasis displays pathognomonic ashen gray hyperpigmentation, producing conspicuous grayish-black skin discoloration on the hands, face, and abdomen.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, crateriform skin ulcer, volcano ulcer, central crust
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Leishmaniasis presents with a pathognomonic crateriform skin ulcer, resembling a volcano with a depressed crusted crater and elevated borders.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, indurated violaceous border, rolled ulcer margin, active rim
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Leishmaniasis exhibits a pathognomonic indurated violaceous border, where active intracellular amastigote replication forms a raised, firm, rolled wall around the ulcer.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, intact cutaneous sensation, preserved light touch, normal pinprick
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Leishmaniasis demonstrates completely intact cutaneous sensation within ulcerated skin lesions, a critical bedside sign distinguishing it from anesthetic leprosy patches.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, smooth firm hepatomegaly, non-tender liver, Kupffer hyperplasia
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Leishmaniasis reveals smooth firm hepatomegaly on physical palpation, resulting from Kupffer cell parasitization and reticuloendothelial hyperplasia without focal nodularity.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, nontender lymphadenopathy, mobile nodes, generalized adenopathy
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Leishmaniasis features generalized nontender lymphadenopathy, with freely mobile, rubbery lymph nodes especially prominent in East African visceral disease.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, granulation base bleeding, friable floor, vascular bed
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Leishmaniasis exhibits prominent granulation base bleeding, as the floor of the ulcer contains dense vascular granulation tissue that oozes blood upon gentle unroofing.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, exudative whitish pseudomembrane, necrotic slough, ulcer crater
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Leishmaniasis presents with an exudative whitish pseudomembrane layering the ulcer bed, formed by coagulated serum, cellular debris, and dead macrophages.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, ear pinna notch, chiclero ulcer, chondral cleft, ear deformity
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Leishmaniasis exhibits a pathognomonic ear pinna notch, resulting from L. mexicana destruction of auricular cartilage in chiclero ulcer.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, nasal septal destruction, septal necrosis, anterior cartilage
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Leishmaniasis presents with pathognomonic nasal septal destruction, where amastigote-driven inflammation selectively erodes the anterior cartilaginous septum.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, uvular granulomatous erosion, palatal ulcer, amputated uvula
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Leishmaniasis displays uvular granulomatous erosion on oral examination, presenting as ragged, detached mucosal margins and total loss of the uvula in advanced espundia.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, brawny facial lymphedema, midfacial swelling, lymphatic obstruction
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Leishmaniasis exhibits brawny facial lymphedema, resulting from chronic granulomatous lymphatic obstruction that thickens the perinasal soft tissues.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, temporal muscle wasting, temporal hollowing, visceral cachexia
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Leishmaniasis displays conspicuous temporal muscle wasting on physical inspection, an unmistakable visual hallmark of advanced systemic consumptive illness.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, abdominal venous distension, collateral veins, portal hypertension
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Leishmaniasis exhibits abdominal venous distension on inspection, provoked by high splenic venous inflow and splenic vein compression of the splanchnic circulation.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, nail bed pallor, severe anemia, conjunctival pallor
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Leishmaniasis reveals dramatic nail bed pallor and porcelain-white conjunctivae on physical examination, reflecting hemoglobin drops to 5-7 g/dL.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, petechial skin purpura, ecchymoses, thrombocytopenia, bleeding
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Leishmaniasis displays petechial skin purpura and spontaneous ecchymoses on the lower extremities, reflecting profound thrombocytopenia secondary to hypersplenism.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, dry thinning hair, brittle hair, alopecia, flag sign
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Leishmaniasis demonstrates dry thinning hair on physical evaluation, driven by profound protein-energy malnutrition and systemic reticuloendothelial inflammation.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, xerosis cutis, ichthyosiform skin, rough scaling
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Leishmaniasis presents with xerosis cutis on physical examination, manifesting as dry, cracked, rough epidermal scaling accompanying visceral wasting.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, hypopigmented facial macules, PKDL macules, butterfly distribution
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Leishmaniasis exhibits hypopigmented facial macules in early post-kala-azar dermal leishmaniasis, representing initial dermal amastigote replication without necrosis.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, perioral nodular eruptions, fleshy papules, chin nodules, PKDL
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Leishmaniasis displays perioral nodular eruptions on dermatological exam, typically seen in advanced PKDL as skin-colored to yellowish nodules packed with parasites.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, nonulcerating verrucous plaques, keloidal lesions, diffuse CL
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Leishmaniasis presents with nonulcerating verrucous plaques in diffuse cutaneous leishmaniasis, reflecting total anergy and unrestrained amastigote proliferation.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, hoarse whispering dysphonia, laryngeal involvement, vocal cords
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Leishmaniasis exhibits hoarse whispering dysphonia on vocal assessment, indicating deep granulomatous infiltration of the true vocal cords and arytenoid cartilages.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, saddle nose deformity, nasal collapse, espundia
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Leishmaniasis exhibits a pathognomonic saddle nose deformity, resulting from extensive chondral liquefaction in late destructive mucocutaneous espundia.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, soft palate granuloma, velvety cobblestone, tonsillar pillar
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Leishmaniasis presents with soft palate granuloma on oral inspection, where irregular granulomatous masses bleed easily on touch and precede palatal perforation.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, localized erythematous papule, inoculation lesion, sandfly bite
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Leishmaniasis initiates as a localized erythematous papule, representing the earliest visible cutaneous physical sign prior to vesiculation and crater formation.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, preserved peripheral nerves, normal great auricular, normal ulnar
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Leishmaniasis displays strictly preserved peripheral nerves on palpation, lacking the thickened, tender cords pathognomonic of tuberculoid or lepromatous leprosy.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, profound pancytopenia, three cell lines, bone marrow depression
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Leishmaniasis exhibits profound pancytopenia on admission CBC, driven by splenic sequestration in an enormous spleen coupled with marrow reticuloendothelial replacement.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, severe normocytic anemia, low hemoglobin, splenic sequestration
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Leishmaniasis exhibits severe normocytic anemia on admission laboratory testing, provoked by hypersplenic red cell pooling, shortened erythrocyte survival, and dyserythropoiesis.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, profound leukopenia, low white count, leukopenia
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Leishmaniasis exhibits profound leukopenia on admission CBC, frequently revealing total leukocyte counts between 1000 and 2500/uL that predispose to secondary infections.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, absolute neutropenia, low ANC, bacterial sepsis risk
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Leishmaniasis exhibits absolute neutropenia on admission differential, representing a critical triage marker that correlates with high susceptibility to fatal bacterial sepsis.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, severe thrombocytopenia, low platelets, bleeding risk
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Leishmaniasis exhibits severe thrombocytopenia on admission CBC, resulting from profound splenic pooling and shortened platelet lifespan in the hyperplastic red pulp.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, polyclonal hypergammaglobulinemia, elevated IgG, astronomical globulin
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Leishmaniasis exhibits polyclonal hypergammaglobulinemia on serum protein electrophoresis, driven by uninhibited, non-specific B-cell activation producing astronomical IgG titers.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, inverted albumin globulin ratio, reversed AG ratio, low albumin
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Leishmaniasis exhibits an inverted albumin globulin ratio on admission biochemistry, where massive hyperglobulinemia and marked hypoalbuminemia reverse the normal A:G ratio.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, marked hypoalbuminemia, low serum albumin, cachectic liver
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Leishmaniasis exhibits marked hypoalbuminemia on admission metabolic panel, resulting from chronic catabolic states, severe malnutrition, and depressed hepatic synthesis.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, intracellular amastigotes, Leishman Donovan bodies, Giemsa stain
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Leishmaniasis exhibits intracellular amastigote visualization (Leishman-Donovan bodies) on tissue smear, providing definitive microbiological gold-standard confirmation.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, splenic aspirate smear, splenic tap, highest sensitivity
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Leishmaniasis exhibits positive splenic aspirate smear results with >95% diagnostic sensitivity, though it carries a known 0.1% risk of life-threatening splenic hemorrhage.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, bone marrow aspirate, sternal marrow, iliac crest, LD bodies
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Leishmaniasis exhibits positive bone marrow aspirate findings with 70-85% sensitivity, representing the safest primary invasive diagnostic modality for visceral disease.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, lymph node aspirate, nodal aspiration, East Africa
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Leishmaniasis exhibits positive lymph node aspirate smears with 50-60% sensitivity, offering an easily accessible, minimally invasive bedside technique in East African patients.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, purplish kinetoplast rod, mitochondrial DNA, LD morphology
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Leishmaniasis exhibits a purplish kinetoplast rod on microscopic examination, a pathognomonic morphological feature distinguishing Leishmania amastigotes from Histoplasma yeasts.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, rK39 dipstick RDT, rapid diagnostic test, kinesin antigen
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Leishmaniasis exhibits a positive rK39 dipstick RDT on point-of-care testing, yielding rapid, highly sensitive bedside serological confirmation for visceral leishmaniasis.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, direct agglutination test, DAT, high titer antibodies
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Leishmaniasis exhibits a positive direct agglutination test (DAT) at high serum dilutions, demonstrating over 95% sensitivity for visceral leishmaniasis in field settings.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, positive Montenegro reaction, leishmanin skin test, DTH induration
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Leishmaniasis exhibits a positive Montenegro reaction (>5 mm induration) in localized cutaneous and mucocutaneous forms, proving intact cell-mediated immunity.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, negative Montenegro reaction, anergic skin test, visceral anergy
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Leishmaniasis exhibits a negative Montenegro reaction during acute visceral disease and diffuse cutaneous disease, reflecting profound disease-induced T-cell anergy.

relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Leishmaniasis demonstrates homogeneous splenomegaly ultrasound findings on bedside POCUS, revealing massive enlargement without discrete focal cysts, infarctions, or abscesses.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING, smooth hepatomegaly ultrasound, uniform liver, no focal lesions
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Leishmaniasis demonstrates smooth hepatomegaly ultrasound features, confirming diffuse Kupffer cell reticuloendothelial expansion and excluding pyogenic or amebic hepatic abscesses.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING, dilated portal vein, splenic hyperflow, portal hypertension
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Leishmaniasis demonstrates a dilated portal vein on abdominal vascular ultrasound, driven by hyperdynamic splenic venous runoff rather than intrahepatic cirrhotic block.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING, absence of splenic abscess, clean splenic parenchyma, no liquefaction
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Leishmaniasis demonstrates absence of splenic abscess on ultrasound evaluation, ruling out melioidosis splenic microabscesses or bacterial splenic collections.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, mild transaminase elevation, AST ALT elevated, mild hepatitis
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Leishmaniasis exhibits mild transaminase elevation on admission liver function tests, reflecting diffuse Kupffer cell and histiocytic infiltration without fulminant hepatocellular necrosis.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, normal serum bilirubin, preserved liver excretion, no cholestasis
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Leishmaniasis exhibits normal serum bilirubin on admission triage labs, excluding acute biliary obstruction, viral hepatitis, and severe fulminant liver failure.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, elevated serum ferritin, hyperferritinemia, macrophage activation
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Leishmaniasis exhibits markedly elevated serum ferritin on triage workup, reflecting extreme reticuloendothelial activation and secondary hemophagocytosis.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, elevated erythrocyte sedimentation, high ESR, extreme inflammation
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Leishmaniasis exhibits an elevated erythrocyte sedimentation rate on admission testing, driven by astronomical serum polyclonal IgG levels and rouleaux formation.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, elevated C reactive protein, high CRP, acute phase response
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Leishmaniasis exhibits elevated C reactive protein on admission triage labs, reflecting continuous macrophage cytokine secretion (IL-1, IL-6, TNF-alpha).

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, microscopic hematuria, mild proteinuria, immune complexes
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Leishmaniasis exhibits microscopic hematuria and mild proteinuria on urinalysis, caused by circulating immune complex deposition in renal glomeruli.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, negative blood malarial smear, no plasmodia, thick thin films
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Leishmaniasis exhibits a negative blood malarial smear on triage evaluation, excluding acute or recurrent malaria in febrile splenomegalic patients.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, dermal scraping smear, slit smear, active ulcer edge, Giemsa
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Leishmaniasis exhibits positive dermal scraping smear findings on admission dermatology triage, confirming cutaneous leishmaniasis with 70-80% sensitivity.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, Novy MacNeal Nicolle culture, NNN medium, promastigote growth
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Leishmaniasis exhibits growth on Novy MacNeal Nicolle culture medium, converting amastigotes into actively swimming flagellated promastigotes for species identification.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, positive kinetoplast DNA PCR, kDNA PCR, molecular detection
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Leishmaniasis exhibits positive kinetoplast DNA PCR results with >98% sensitivity, identifying low parasite burdens in mucosal and cutaneous lesions.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, urine Leishmania antigen, KAtex, non-invasive diagnosis
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Leishmaniasis exhibits positive urine Leishmania antigen detection on non-invasive screening, indicating active visceral parasite replication.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, normal blood coagulation profile, normal PT INR, preserved synthesis
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Leishmaniasis exhibits a normal blood coagulation profile on admission triage, confirming preserved hepatic synthetic clotting factors and excluding acute liver failure.

relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Leishmaniasis exhibits histiocytic vacuolar infiltration on punch biopsy of cutaneous lesions, showing classic Leishman-Donovan bodies within vacuolated macrophages.

relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Leishmaniasis exhibits a negative acid fast stain on admission tissue cytology, ruling out Mycobacterium leprae and Mycobacterium tuberculosis.

relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Leishmaniasis exhibits a normal peripheral blood smear architecture regarding leukocyte morphology, definitively excluding acute leukemia as the etiology of pancytopenia.

relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Leishmaniasis demonstrates absence of biliary dilatation on bedside ultrasound, excluding extrahepatic biliary tree obstruction or choledocholithiasis.

relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Leishmaniasis demonstrates a normal plain chest radiograph on initial triage, distinguishing uncomplicated visceral disease from active cavitary pulmonary tuberculosis.
